_about: Hand-verified ground truth for the 20-app seeded sample (data/sample.json), built BEFORE reading agent output. 'how' = browser: read in the browser against primary docs this session; reviewer: reviewer knowledge of well-known public docs, not re-opened (flagged for human spot-check). Lists = all accepted answers where the docs allow more than one fair reading. mcp=null means not confidently verifiable -> not scored.
